description: Searches verified tax figures and rules (rates, thresholds, caps, allowances, dates) for one country and returns up to 10 matching facts with their id, value, tax year and status. Each fact has an assurance: quoted (a figure the source prints), excerpt (a rule or value-less fact whose label is a title: fetch it with get_tax_fact for the quoted rule) or summary (a rule or value-less fact whose label is our one-line summary: fetch it with get_tax_fact and state the rule from the source quote). Returns not_in_kb when nothing matches.

country.description: Country: au (Australia), ca (Canada), nz (New Zealand), uk (United Kingdom), us (United States).

query.description: Words naming the figure, e.g. 'standard deduction single' or 'personal allowance'.

tax_year.description: Tax year as the country writes it, e.g. 2026 or 2026-27. Omit for the latest.

name: find_tax_facts
title: Find tax facts
